headline: Mayor offers to improve communication with DEI committee after members describe breakdown since July
summary: Members said the committee is volunteer-only, down three members, and has lost its staff liaison. The mayor said he will attend meetings if helpful, meet with the presumptive chair, and work with the council liaison. Members will send notes on the 2026 annual committee report by end of day Monday.
decisions: Selection of committee chairs tabled because there was no quorum.
discussion: Mayor's visit and communication: The mayor came to hear about barriers and said he would work with staff, the city manager's office, and the council. Members said communication broke down after July and that their input may not be valued.

Committee capacity and recruitment: Members said they cannot take on the work a staff liaison once did. They were unsure whether to recruit new members now, and two possible candidates were mentioned.

Goals and council presentations: Members discussed goals such as outreach, attending city events, and making residents aware of the committee. Some asked to present to the City Council on a regular basis.
Proclamation timing: Members said a proclamation draft changed at the last minute without notice, which felt disrespectful to them.

decision_evidence.quote: Are we going to table the selection of chairs since we don't have a quorum? Yes.
